title: Cinch's Lost Mob Grinder
description: Simply adds lost mob grinders that spawn around the overworld, kind of like an easter egg feature.
body:
[![Partner](https://i.imgur.com/sf01XOZ.png)](https://billing.kinetichosting.net/aff.php?aff=1088)

Cinch's Lost Mob Grinders adds three new overworld structures. All three of these structures are lost/abandoned/ruined versions of mob grinders. These structures come in a normal variant that spawns under most overworld biomes, a badlands variant, and a lush caves variant that spawns undrr jungles as well as lush caves.

These lost mob grinders contain some basic loot and can be fixed up and returned to working condition. This structure is very rare and more of an easter egg feature.

There is built in compatibility with one of my other mods, Cinch's Missing Blocks. If you play with both mods, sometimes the lost mob grinders will spawn with modded blocks from Cinch's Missing Blocks.

Feel free to use this mod modpacks!
